answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-attendance record over ninety days verified by merkle inclusion proofs. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a ferrous for each honest agent, a zenith for the network, and a trellis that marks verified work.
